definitions.gloss: koban; oval gold coin of the Edo period
definitions.explanation: A flat, oval gold coin used as currency in Japan during the Edo period (1603–1868), and a familiar symbol of old wealth.

examples.japanese: {小判|こばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小判|こばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詰|つ}まった→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: A box stuffed with koban appeared in the period drama.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{小判|こばん}⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: In the Edo period, a single koban is said to have been worth a considerable amount.

notes:
An oval gold coin of the Edo period and a familiar emblem of historical wealth in Japan. It appears constantly in period dramas and folktales.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小判|こばん}{型|がた}: koban-shaped (oval)
- ⟦{大判|おおばん}→大判：12262_ooban⟧{小判|こばん}: large and small gold coins (great riches)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小判|こばん}: 'a koban to a cat' — casting pearls before swine; giving something valuable to someone who cannot appreciate it.
